items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Any way, I used to go by and sit in with the band, so Don Byas told me one night

ctx.x: Woody Herman. But he couldn't play no more piano than me, and I can't play piano at all, you know. But Dizzy was very patient, he's a very patient man and he was schooling this little cat. Any way, I used to go by and sit in with the band, so Don Byas told me one night, he says, hey man, he says why don't you come on and take this job.
Can you hold that just a second, I hear a squeak?
